children: The French government will revise downward its forecast for economic growth this year to around 0.5% growth from a previous forecast of 0.7%, French daily Les Echos said on Friday, citing sources.
This comes after INSEE revised its economic forecast for the euro zone's second-largest economy lower on Thursday, predicting growth of just 0.4% this year.
A spokesperson for the French finance ministry did not respond to a request for comment.
